test_title: PYST 65: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Mountaineering requires a combination of physical strength, __endurance__, technical skill and mental fortitude.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (1) Weakness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Endurance"** means the ability to withstand hardship, stress, or physical pain over a long period; stamina. (धैर्य या सहनशक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** Marathon runners need great endurance to complete the race.
 
 
 
• **"Weakness"** refers to a lack of strength, power, or endurance; the state of being feeble or easily fatigued. (कमज़ोरी)
 
 
• **Example:** After recovering from the illness, he still felt some weakness in his legs.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'endurance'** is **'weakness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Weakness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Persistence** (दृढ़ता): The quality of continuing firmly despite difficulty or opposition.

 
 
• **Example:** Her persistence helped her achieve success in business.
 
 
 
• **Enthusiasm** (उत्साह): Intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
 
 
• **Example:** He spoke about his new project with great enthusiasm.
 
 
 
• **Timidity** (लज्जा या डरपोकपन): Lack of courage or confidence; being easily frightened.
 
 
• **Example:** His timidity prevented him from expressing his true feelings.
 
 

30:T97e,

The correct answer is **option 4.**
